name: pr-lens
title_zh: 代码改动自动长成会动的架构图，PR 里直接看
tagline_zh: 不用再对着 diff 脑补数据流。它把改动画成会动的架构图，PR 里直接看，评审像看动画片一样清楚。
tagline_en: Stop mentally replaying diffs. It turns changes into animated architecture diagrams inside the PR, so reviews.
desc_en: WHAT: Draws a code change or part of a codebase as an animated architecture or data-flow diagram, on its own or in a pull request. WHEN: asked to diagram, visualise or explain a change or a system, or when a pull request should carry a diagram. KEYWORDS: PR Lens, diagram, architecture, data flow, visualise, visualize, pull request
why_zh: 它不画静态示意图，而是按提交顺序重放数据流，让「哪里改了、影响谁」自己动起来。评审从猜变成看。
why_en: It doesn't draw a static picture—it replays data flow commit-by-commit, so what changed and what it affects animates itself.
limit_zh: 只认代码仓库里的真实结构，不认你脑中的理想架构；画不出手绘草图风格，也不做交互式下钻。产物是动画图，不是文档。
limit_en: Only reflects actual repo structure, not your ideal architecture; no sketch-style or interactive drill-down. Output is an animation, not.
title_en: Code changes that grow into animated architecture.
